source_paper.title: Temporal Alignment of LLMs through Cycle Encoding for Long-Range Time Representations

fidelity_items.paper_spec: C(y) = (y - 4) mod 60 for CE, astronomical extension for BCE
fidelity_items.rationale: Exact mathematical formulation implemented without modification.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: r = alpha + beta * theta (literal Eq. 2 fails to distinguish 1965 from 2025)
fidelity_items.implementation: adapted_monotonic: r = alpha + beta * theta + gamma * floor((year - 4)/60)
fidelity_items.rationale: The published literal formula in v3 assigns identical radius to all 60-year co-phase years, contradicting the stated intent to separate distinct cycles. Adapted monotonic radius resolves epoch separation.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: x = r * cos(theta), y = r * sin(theta)
fidelity_items.rationale: Standard coordinate transformation from polar to Cartesian.
Standard Transformer-style sinusoidal position/time encoding matching Eq. 4.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: h' = h + TE(x) + TE(y) added directly to year-associated token embeddings
fidelity_items.implementation: inject_temporal_embedding at token positions matching year substring
fidelity_items.rationale: Preserves paper principle: no virtual tokens, no seam token 14, direct embedding summation.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: Trainable rank-decomposition matrices added to each layer, frozen pretrained parameters (module names unstated)
fidelity_items.implementation: q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj (112 attention modules, r=8, alpha=16)
fidelity_items.rationale: Attention projections are the standard canonical LoRA implementation; avoids confounding with partner's MLP MaT-LoRA.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: L_T = delta * L_intra + (1 - delta) * L_inter, with delta = 1.0 (Section 4.2)
fidelity_items.rationale: Faithful to published experimental configuration: intra-class pulling only; inter-class separation is inactive.

fidelity_items.implementation: LoRAEWCLoss: diagonal Fisher accumulated across continual pretraining stages on trainable LoRA parameters
fidelity_items.rationale: Backbone W0 is frozen (requires_grad=False) and yields zero gradient penalty. Fisher must be computed and applied to LoRA parameters across continual stages.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: Proprietary/unreleased synthetic dataset of 137,090 QA pairs
fidelity_items.implementation: Replaced by TempUN Small train_nwp.jsonl (2,461 samples) across year:1947, 1984, 2022
fidelity_items.rationale: Authors have not released TempLS. Evaluation must use the standardized internal benchmark.

fidelity_items.paper_spec: Paper evaluated Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, LLaMA2-7B, LLaMA2-13B (zero experiments on 0.5B)
fidelity_items.rationale: Exploration of architectural scalability at 0.5B parameter tier; cannot reproduce 64.96% paper reported metric.
